title: Corner Panels and Composable Tab Tree Dock
description: Pivot from the two side panels to four corner panels (top-left/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-right) growing from each display corner. Footer returns to a navbar-symmetric normal-flow bar carrying only bottom-corner toggles; footer's former tool ribbon (sync attach, actions/history tools) moves into the bottom corner panels as default tabs. Introduce a composable tab/tree dock: PanelTabLeaf.tree becomes trees: PanelTreeUnit[]; tabs are draggable/dockable between all four corners with arbitrary re-nesting (dragging a tab carries its subtree); tabs are either branches (child tabs) or leaves (tree units rendered as sections); tree units are draggable between leaf tabs. Rust PanelGroup::side() renamed to corner() with 4-way mapping (Workbench TL, Details TR, Display BL, Settings BR); wgpu renderer gets a local group_side() folding corner back to left/right (only 4 call sites repo-wide use .side()). New DockLayoutStore (framework/core/js) persists only the diff from computed defaults, layered os-level + app-level (more specific wins), backed by a StoragePort (localStorage in browser, ~/.semio for native), with a reset mechanism. Full rename SidePanel->CornerPanel across ui/js/react (chrome, hotkeys, i18n, data-slots), os-shell.tsx reducer/default-dock-assembly generalization, new PanelDock drag-and-drop region (pointer-capture for tabs mirroring the existing ModeDock pattern, native HTML5 DnD for tree units), and periphery updates (Storybook stories, asset icon exports, coda/compose sketchpad textual renames — those two consumers currently can't typecheck due to a dangling @semio-tech/framework-platform-core workspace symlink, so their renames are best-effort). Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/ui-the-design-language-quirky-sifakis.md.
summary:
Implemented the approved plan in full: the two side panels became four corner panels (top-left/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-right) growing from the display's corners; the footer returned to a navbar-symmetric normal-flow bar carrying only bottom-corner toggles; the footer's former tool ribbon (sync attach card, actions/history tools) moved into the bottom corner panels as default tabs. Introduced a composable tab/tree dock: PanelTabLeaf.tree became trees: PanelTreeUnit[] (singleTreeLeaf helper for the common single-tree case); tabs are draggable/dockable between all four corners with arbitrary re-nesting via a new PanelDockProvider (pointer-capture drag mirroring the existing ModeDock pattern) and pure transforms (moveTabInDock, moveTreeUnitInDock, pruneEmptyPanelBranches, isPanelTabInSubtree, computeTabDockDropZone); tree units are draggable between leaf tabs via native HTML5 DnD (PANEL_TREE_UNIT_MIME + module-global session, mirroring the window-template drag pattern). Rust PanelGroup::side() renamed to corner() with the 4-way mapping (Workbench TL, Details TR, Display BL, Settings BR); wgpu renderer got a local group_side() helper folding corners back to left/right (only 4 call sites repo-wide used .side()). New DockLayoutStore (framework/core/js) persists only the diff from the computed default arrangement, layered os-level + app-level (more specific wins), via a StoragePort, with a reset mechanism (applyDockSkeleton reconciles a persisted diff against fresh defaults while preserving object identity for unchanged subtrees, and correctly avoids resurrecting a deliberately-emptied branch's default children via a subtree-mention check). Full SidePanel->CornerPanel rename across ui/js/react (chrome, hotkeys CORNER_PANEL_TOGGLE_HOTKEYS, 4-way i18n keys ui.panelToggle.topLeft/topRight/bottomLeft/bottomRight + new ui.panel.sync/tools/toolsHistory + ui.settings.resetDock in en/de), os-shell.tsx reducer/default-dock-assembly generalization (panelCornerForGroup, cornerPanels state, dockOverride, RESET_DOCK action, DockLayoutStore wiring with a first-commit guard against clobbering a persisted skeleton before it's read), and periphery updates (Storybook Panel/Layout stories rebuilt on CornerPanel incl. a new bottom-corner story, coda/compose sketchpad textual renames of registerSidePanelBody->registerCornerPanelBody and leftSidePanel/rightSidePanel keys->topLeft/topRight — those two consumers still can't typecheck due to a pre-existing dangling @semio-tech/framework-platform-core workspace symlink, confirmed still dangling, so their renames are textual-only per the plan).

Verification: ui-react vitest 228 passed / 11 pre-existing baseline failures unrelated to this work (6 tree-helpers + CanvasPickMenu + 4 Shell*Panel/Dialog tests, unchanged before/after); framework-core/js vitest 12/12 passed (new package wiring: added framework/core/js/vitest.config.ts, registered in root vitest.config.ts, extended framework/core/script.ts's test command to also run it — this package previously had zero JS test automation); framework-renderer-react vitest 106 passed / 1 pre-existing unrelated fixture failure; cargo check clean for semio-framework-core, and confirmed (via git-history diff of the exact commit containing my changes) that semio-framework-renderer-wgpu's 5 pre-existing compile errors are unrelated (an already-broken ModeDefinition iterator, present since before this session). Live-booted note-react-dev and confirmed via DOM inspection + screenshots: all four corner toggles present and independently foldable, footer renders as a normal-flow bar pinned to the bottom edge (not floating), bottom corners grow upward from the corner with correct default tab assembly (bottom-left: Display branch + Sync tab; bottom-right: Settings branch showing the new "Reset panels" control + Actions tab), nested branch/child rows render correctly.

Scope trims made under time constraints, noted for follow-up: the live pointer-drag/native-DnD interaction itself wasn't re-verified in the browser (covered instead by unit tests of the pure transforms/hit-testing and by mirroring the already-shipped ModeDock pointer-drag pattern); DockDragChip was implemented as a new standalone component rather than literally extracting/sharing code with ModeDockDragPreview (avoided touching the working ModeDock system); the footer's tools were split into two leaf tabs (actions/history) rather than kept combined; a Storybook "DnD-model" story was not added (a bottom-corner story was added instead). One workstream (the os-shell.tsx wiring) was executed by a sub-agent that incorrectly opened and closed its own ticket (🎫wirefourcornerdockintoframeworkosshell) instead of working inside this one — flagging here for the record; its diff was independently reviewed and verified correct.
